summary: Fixed the package to follow the docs: column numbering, exponent numbers, operator precedence (prefix minus looser than ^, ^ right-grouped), range corners in any order, empty cells, %.10g number text, bool cell type, cell order, deduplicated refs, SUM-family skipping numeric text in references, lazy IF, ROUND precision and non-finite results.
